text: Enilive is Eni's company dedicated to mobility products and services; after Eni sold further stakes to KKR, KKR completed the acquisition of a 30% stake of Enilive's share capital in April 2025, leaving Eni with the majority.

source.name: Eni press release: Eni – KKR completes the acquisition of an additional stake in the share capital of Enilive
source.quote: Upon completion of the transaction, KKR owns an overall 30% stake of Enilive’s share capital.

additionalSources.name: Eni press release: Enilive becomes Serie A Title sponsor with sponsorship agreement up until 2027
additionalSources.quote: Enilive, Eni's company dedicated to mobility products and services, will be the Title sponsor of Serie A starting from the 2024/25 championship and covering three seasons.
